cases.title: Toolbox: physical reasoning
cases.scope: SET, or asset-only SCENE when the source has multiple registered sets
cases.create: Texture this toolbox as a used but maintained workshop toolbox. Make the body dark petrol-blue painted steel, the handle aged hardwood and the latches brass. Add restrained paint loss at plausible exposed edges and repeated contact areas, revealing steel underneath. Add subtle accumulated grime in protected recesses. Keep broad painted surfaces mostly clean. Build everything as editable Open Painter material components.
refinements: Make it look approximately five years more worn. Preserve the existing material identity and wear logic.
Reduce the wear by 50%. Keep the existing wear locations and patterns. Do not regenerate or replace them.
requirements: The petrol-blue painted steel body, aged hardwood handle and brass latches read as distinct materials in the correct regions.
Paint loss exposes steel at plausible exposed edges and repeated contact areas; broad panels stay mostly clean and recess grime stays restrained.
Material and wear components remain independently editable with ordinary Open Painter controls.
The five-years-more-worn revision preserves material identities and the existing physical wear logic.
The final revision reduces visible wear by 50% while preserving exact existing wear locations and patterns without regeneration.
cases.edit_proof: Demonstrate the independent material controls and requested revisions; retain the three scored material checkpoints.

cases.title: Chair: resist grunge
cases.create: Texture this as a nearly new premium contemporary chair. Use dark walnut for the wooden frame and burnt-orange woven upholstery. The walnut should have directional grain appropriate to each wooden member. The upholstery should have subtle woven structure at believable physical scale. Do not add dirt, damage, scratches, edge wear or artificial aging.
refinements: Change only the upholstery to deep forest green.
Make only the upholstery weave twice as fine. Preserve its color and all wooden surfaces.
requirements: Dark walnut frame and burnt-orange woven upholstery cover the correct complete chair regions.
The nearly new finish contains no dirt, damage, scratches, edge wear or artificial aging.
Wood grain follows each member and fabric weave has believable consistent physical scale.
The first refinement changes only upholstery to deep forest green and preserves the frame and existing weave.
The second refinement makes only the weave twice as fine, preserving its color and every wooden surface.
cases.edit_proof: Demonstrate the independent material controls and requested revisions; retain the three scored material checkpoints.

cases.title: Boots: geometry awareness
cases.scope: SET, or asset-only SCENE when required
cases.create: Texture these as mustard-yellow rubber work boots with matte black soles. Add wet dark mud primarily to the soles and lower 25% of the boots, with sparse upward splashes. Keep the upper shafts mostly clean. The mud must remain an independently editable effect.
refinements: The mud has dried overnight. Preserve its exact spatial distribution. Make only the mud lighter, rougher and visually dry.
Reduce the amount of mud by half while preserving the character of its distribution.
requirements: Mustard-yellow rubber, matte black soles and independently editable wet dark mud remain distinct materials.
Mud is concentrated on soles and the lower 25% with sparse upward splashes; upper shafts remain mostly clean.
Mud color, roughness and coverage can be revised independently from the rubber.
The dry-mud revision changes only mud appearance while preserving its exact spatial distribution.
The last revision reduces mud amount by half while preserving the character of its distribution.
cases.edit_proof: Demonstrate the independent material controls and requested revisions; retain the three scored material checkpoints.

cases.title: Vase: precision
cases.scope: SET, or asset-only SCENE when required
cases.create: Create a warm ivory glazed ceramic finish. Add exactly two thin cobalt-blue horizontal bands around the upper third of the vase, with equal width and a clean gap between them. Add a narrow metallic gold rim around the mouth. Keep each component independently editable.
refinements: Change only the two cobalt bands to dark red.
Move both bands slightly lower while preserving their width, spacing and relationship to each other.
requirements: The vase reads as warm ivory glazed ceramic with a narrow metallic gold rim at the mouth.
Exactly two thin cobalt-blue horizontal bands have equal width and a clean gap around the upper third.
Glaze, bands and gold rim are independently editable.
The first refinement changes only both band colors to dark red.
Both bands move slightly lower together while retaining exact width, spacing and their relationship.
cases.edit_proof: Demonstrate the independent material controls and requested revisions; retain the three scored material checkpoints.

cases.title: Rocks: environmental reasoning
cases.scope: SET, or asset-only SCENE when required
cases.create: Texture these rocks as pale weathered sandstone. Add moss primarily to upward-facing sheltered surfaces and cracks. Keep steep exposed vertical faces mostly clear and undersides almost completely free of moss. Add subtle damp darkening in deep recesses. Maintain consistent material scale across every rock.
refinements: Make the moss warmer and more olive without changing where it grows.
Reduce moss coverage by approximately 40% while preserving its environmental placement logic.
requirements: Every rock reads as pale weathered sandstone with consistent material scale.
Moss primarily occupies upward-facing sheltered surfaces and cracks; steep exposed faces and undersides remain mostly free.
Deep recesses have subtle damp darkening and moss, stone and dampness remain separately editable.
The olive recolor leaves exactly where the moss grows unchanged.
The final revision reduces moss coverage by approximately 40% while preserving environmental placement logic.
cases.edit_proof: Demonstrate the independent material controls and requested revisions; retain the three scored material checkpoints.

intervention_labels.0: autonomous success when actual requirements pass

note: The primary benchmark is five independent H-enabled sessions, one per exact art brief. Optional controlled comparison uses P/H and three repeats. No legacy 20/24 gate or six-dimension threshold applies.
